amendments.reason: observation_operators.mycelial_area tied the detection density to the model cell (one segment per cell side), which made the area observable change with the grid and the plan's own grid-convergence check ill-posed; found while building stage 0, before any check was recorded or any fit run. The detection density is now a declared constant, 1 per millimetre, independent of the grid. No model, bound, rule, hold-out or other setting changed.

check_values_source: COLONY-001 stage 0 software-check value: an artificial framework value inside the plan's bounds, declared for the grid, solver and symmetry checks; no estimate of either species.
